historical_excluded_totem.reason: Official29.0 reverted the Hero Power pool from Strength to Wrath of Air; retain the complete old row as evidence, not a default member.

primary_evidence.supports: Wrath of Air replaces Strength in the Shaman Hero Power pool.
2-mana Ghoul Charge,1/1Charge and end-of-turn death; printed Ghoul row and existing adapter remain independent.

policy.scope: Default canonical roles only; cosmetic variants, upgraded powers and qualified alternate targeting remain separately reviewed actual dependencies.
policy.totems: Four complete current basic identities; exclude those already on the actor current physical board. Owning all four disables manual use. Query uses only the actor public board; resolve through existing attributed random SummonByCard.
policy.ghoul: Reuse the complete existing charged Ghoul with its native controller-end self-destruction; no fake temporary marker.
policy.bindings: Only fill the four currently-unbound representative starting hero definitions in the constructed compilation. Default representative remains unchanged.
